description: The characteristic functions of bounded universal and existential quantification are respectively \(\prod_{i<b}\chi_R(\bar x,i)\) and \(1\mathbin{\dot-}z(\sum_{i<b}\chi_R(\bar x,i))\), including empty bounds.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.bounded_quantifier_characteristics.{u_1} {α : Type u_1}
  (R : α → ℕ → Prop) (x : α) (b : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic (fun x => ∀ i < b, R x i) x =
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedProduct
        (fun x i => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic (R x) i) x b ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic (fun x => ∃ i < b, R x i) x =
      1 -
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.zeroTest
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSum
            (fun x i => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic (R x) i) x b)
